description: This file defines a PangeaGuardrail class that integrates with the Pangea AI Guard API to scan inputs and outputs for content moderation and policy violations in a FastAPI-based application. It includes helper classes, exception handling, API call logic, and hook implementations for pre- and post-LLM request processing.
